entities.summary: Tigran Nalbandian (b. 1975-06-05, Yerevan) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yerevan and Armenia. Known in the fields of armenia, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
